title: Morning rush in Houston: every bus and train, 6:30 to 9:30 am
description:
The morning rush in Houston, 6:30 to 9:30 am, in 25 seconds. Every bus and train inside the city on an average October weekday.

The timetables are from October 2026. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and placed each vehicle by its schedule. Vehicles outside the Houston city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Local, Park & Ride, Express and Rail.

Busiest moment of the morning: 559 vehicles at 7:35 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable and leaves out Columbus Day (October 12).
